title: Bronze Layer Contract v1.0.0
description:
Bronze is all-VARCHAR by design. Every column arrives as the characters the
source wrote: no cast, no null coercion, no sentinel handling. A bronze layer
that casts is a bronze layer that has already lost data -- and the four
known-defect tests need to FAIL on bronze, which they cannot do if bronze has
already fixed the defect.

The _bronze_* provenance block is NOT uniform across sources, and the contract
says so rather than pretending. The HTTP sources (Montgomery, TxDOT) write six:
_bronze_source, _bronze_dataset, _bronze_load_ts, _bronze_page, _bronze_raw_path
and _bronze_row_sha256, because their unit of raw preservation is a page and
each row's provenance is a row hash inside it. FARS writes five --
_bronze_source, _bronze_dataset, _bronze_load_ts, _bronze_member and
_bronze_zip_sha256 -- because its unit of raw preservation is the annual ZIP,
and a per-row hash inside a file that is restated wholesale would be provenance
theatre. Requiring all six everywhere would fail every FARS page for a
difference that is correct.

`_bronze_dataset` carries the Socrata dataset id for Montgomery, the layer name
for TxDOT and THE YEAR for FARS. That last one is load-bearing: neither the FARS
vehicle nor the person file publishes a YEAR column, and ST_CASE restarts every
year, so without _bronze_dataset their natural keys would collide across six
years and silently merge unrelated records.

montgomery.bhju-22kf.title: Montgomery County Incidents, raw
montgomery.bhju-22kf.description: One row per crash per bronze partition. Overlapping partitions are expected and are what silver's SCD2 dedupes; report_number is therefore NOT unique across a multi-partition read, only within one. `:id` is Socrata's row identity.

latitude.description: String, always populated: zero nulls and zero zeroes in 132,190 rows. A null check passes and the row can still be 170 km outside the county -- which is the point of the defect.

driver_substance_abuse.description: The crash-level `, `-joined concatenation of every driver's value: 121 distinct strings mixing both dictionary generations.

_bronze_source.description: Ingest source key: montgomery | txdot | fars.

_bronze_dataset.description: Socrata dataset id, TxDOT layer name, or FARS year.

_bronze_load_ts.description: Partition stamp, millisecond UTC, lexically sortable.

_bronze_raw_path.description: The raw response file this row was parsed from.

_bronze_row_sha256.description: Canonical hash of the source row; what silver's SCD2 diffs restatements on.

montgomery.mmzv-x632.title: Montgomery County Drivers, raw
montgomery.mmzv-x632.description: One row per driver per bronze partition. Carries denormalised crash-level attributes (weather, light, lat/long), so aggregating those off this table overcounts multi-vehicle crashes by ~1.87x before dedupe and ~1.77x after.

injury_severity.description: Also re-cased by the 2024 dictionary generation change: 11 distinct values across both cases, including SQL NULL.

driver_substance_abuse.description: Single-valued at THIS grain: one driver, one value. 21 distinct across both dictionary generations.

montgomery.n7fk-dce5.title: Montgomery County Non-Motorists, raw
montgomery.n7fk-dce5.description: One row per non-motorist per bronze partition. person_id is NOT unique: 9 ids appear twice under one report_number, distinguished only by `:id` and disagreeing on a denormalised crash-level field.

txdot.cris_crash.title: TxDOT CRIS crash, raw
txdot.cris_crash.description: One row per crash per bronze partition, from an ArcGIS FeatureServer. All attributes are strings including the dates (esriFieldTypeString). Geometry is preserved in its native wkid 3081; reprojection is a transformation and belongs in silver.

rpt_latitude.description: Officer-reported. Null for 68,932 of the 91,876 rows that have a CRIS-derived pair.

amend_supp_fl.description: '1' on 5,936 of 100,000 rows. Late amendment is a first-class concept here, which is why silver is SCD2 and not append.

ESRI_OID.description: Service-assigned, NOT a TxDOT key. A layer rebuild reshuffles it; crash_id is the natural key silver diffs on.

fars.accident.title: FARS accident, raw
fars.accident.description: One row per (year, ST_CASE) per bronze partition. Column set differs by year -- 96 columns in 2019, 85 in 2024 -- so every read must union by name. Sentinel values are preserved verbatim, including the year-to-year decimal formatting drift (77.7777 in 2019, 77.77770000 in 2024) that defeats string matching.

_bronze_dataset.description: The FARS year. The ONLY place the year appears for the vehicle and person members.

_bronze_member.description: The member name inside the annual ZIP.

_bronze_zip_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole annual ZIP. FARS is restated wholesale, so the zip hash IS the row's provenance.

fars.vehicle.title: FARS vehicle, raw
fars.vehicle.description: One row per (year, ST_CASE, VEH_NO). NOTE: no YEAR column. The year is only in _bronze_dataset.

_bronze_dataset.description: The FARS year. The ONLY place the year appears for the vehicle and person members.

_bronze_member.description: The member name inside the annual ZIP.

_bronze_zip_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole annual ZIP. FARS is restated wholesale, so the zip hash IS the row's provenance.

fars.person.title: FARS person, raw
fars.person.description: One row per (year, ST_CASE, VEH_NO, PER_NO). NOTE: no YEAR column. INJ_SEV carries three different kinds of not-a-severity: 5 injured-severity-unknown, 6 died-prior-to-crash, 9 unknown.
